notes:
Added Registration codes (entry / withdrawal) as a new list in SAM Codes & Schools, and the updated zip is attached. I checked it against a stand-in database in light and dark mode; it hasn’t been run against your real SAM yet.

What it pulls: the list comes from SAM’s RegistrationCodes table. It shows each code’s Code, Description, In / Out and Active, so entry codes and withdrawal codes are easy to tell apart.
Getting it from SAM: the list has its own Copy query and Import this list buttons, and saves as registration_codes.csv.
All-in-one query: registration codes are also included in that query now. If you’ve already imported sam_all_codes.csv, run the updated query once more to pick them up.
Filters: once the codes are loaded, filtering on a student’s registration code offers them in the Choose... list. That covers registration history and the enrollment audit.
